question: What attainment becomes possible after six months of proper Kula participation?
premises: Participation in Kula knowledge is the cause
A period of six months is specified
One becomes a recipient of accomplishment
inference: Through enjoyment of Kula knowledge for six months, one becomes fit for accomplishment
uncertainties: The term saṃbhogāt may imply ritual union or experiential participation
plain_english: Through participation in Kula knowledge, after six months one becomes a recipient of accomplishment.
